items.title: Grok Zero-Click Attack Steals Chat Data Using Encrypted Prompt Injection
items.description: A newly disclosed attack can turn a routine “summarize this page” request in xAI’s Grok web chat into a silent theft of the user’s name, coarse location, subscription tier, and the prompt history of the active conversation.
